translation_notes: RDF.first/RDF.rest/OWL_NS.unionOf/OWL_NS.intersectionOf become rdf:first/rdf:rest/owl:unionOf/owl:intersectionOf; the region only reads the graph, so nothing else changes
the draft's 'owl-ns' prefix (mechanically derived from the OWL_NS variable name) is not usable outside islands (a hyphen is subtraction in Python); declared as owl: instead

the OWL_NS = Namespace(...) binding is dropped, absorbed by @prefix owl:. NOTE: this region's own doctest still calls namespace_manager.bind('owl', OWL_NS, ...) and the full module exports OWL_NS, so a whole-file translation would have to keep the Namespace object next to the @prefix declaration (@prefix produces no runtime object)

the graph traversal itself (subjects/transitive_subjects/objects, RDF list walking through OWLRDFListProxy) has no island form: ldpy offers no query/filter island, so 40 of the region's 45 lines are untouched Python
context shim: infixowl_ctx.py re-exports Class/Individual/OWLRDFListProxy from rdflib.extras.infixowl (upstream of the vendored copy); imported identically by both sides
demo harness added identically to both sides: the docstring's own scenario (a union class and an intersection class) is rebuilt and the pair compared on demo_graph + stdout
